ratings_why.fun: Five real build paths and a clean growth ladder (Grub and Nursemaid, then Bee Orchid and Mummers, then Bettie), but early tempo hangs on what the shop happens to show.
ratings_why.distinct: Earns 8 over 7 because the shop becomes a menu of texts: Refresh, Freeze and the Stock left behind are choices about what your units become, which no tribe today does.

verdict_why: v3 cleared the Stock and Bee Orchid readings; what's left is hot high rolls for the owner to balance, not fixes.

points.text: Bettie Underhill scales with guises times Changelings, so she grows quadratically, and Grandfer Acorn or Tam Twice can copy her. That's a great capstone chase; the owner may want her per-guise gain capped if tests run away.
Tier 1 tempo is shop luck: a 2/2 Foundling wearing a weak Tier 1 text loses early fights. A Tier 1 Changeling with a decent body when it has no guise would steady turns 1 to 3.

Coat-Peg Steward only pays after your own Changelings die, so it's late and reactive for a Tier 5 direction card. Letting it start the fight wearing the guise of the Changeling beside it would give it a plan.
Pip Unlike's mirror only changes texts that name left or right, which is mostly Pass. A small bonus when its mirror changes something would make it a pick, not filler.
Golden Inside-Out Tod takes all of a sold unit's stats, so you can sell an outgrown golden and keep its body. Fun pivot tool; worth the owner's eye with Moll's Stocks as cheap fodder.

standouts.why: Wicker Moll turns every Guise into two copies of a text and fills the board for Bettie; a clear Tier 5 direction card.
Tam Twice copying your own carry is the tribe's best hidden combo and now has clear rules.
Hoverfly Guest makes reading the next opponent's board matter from Tier 3.

weakest.why: Pip Unlike's mirror rarely changes anything.
Coat-Peg Steward is reactive and in-fight only at a tier that should set the build.
Porter of the Seven Doors is a pure enabler with a thin body; fine, but nobody is excited to buy it.

flags.note: Guises times Changelings, copied by Grandfer or Tam and made golden by the Lady, can reach hundreds of stats a turn.
Tod plus Moll's 1-gold Stocks turns uncapped saved gold into stats and Bettie stacks; bounded by gold, but the high roll is very high.
Grandfer holding three copies of the same payoff text (Moll or Bettie) stacks, since copied texts each work.
